messages.privacy.title: Privacy notice (draft)
messages.privacy.status: Draft: waiting for legal review and for review of the Telugu and Hindi text. Do not rely on it as final.
messages.privacy.who.p: Pushkara Mitra is an independent app, not an official service of any government, temple trust or the Pushkaralu organisers. It is run by Krishna Murthy Raju G, an individual, who decides how your information is used.
messages.privacy.what.p: Only if you sign in with Google: the name and email address of your Google account. We never see your Google password. We ask for nothing else and do not use your location, contacts, phone number or photos.
messages.privacy.keep.p: If you use My Group, we keep the group's name, your first name and your membership until the group ends (after 14 days), or until you leave, are removed or delete your account. Your position is shared with your group only while the Group or Map screen is open, and is never stored. If you send us an email from Contact us, we keep it for at least one year. If you apply as a partner, we keep your application, and we count app opens without knowing who you are. If remembering is switched on, a small signed cookie holding your name and email stays on this device for up to 7 days, until you sign out. Our hosting provider, Cloudflare, handles the technical details of each request, such as your IP address, to deliver the app.
messages.privacy.child.p: You are asked to say that a parent or guardian agrees. This is a declaration only; we are taking legal advice on whether stronger checks are needed. Do not sign in if you do not have that permission.
messages.privacy.choices.p: You can use the app without signing in. You can sign out and delete at any time on the "Delete my account and data" screen. You can also remove the app's access in your Google Account settings.
messages.delete.title: Delete my account and data
messages.delete.what: What this app holds about you: only what you chose to share, with your consent. That is your sign-in record and consent choices, your group membership with your first name, and any partner request you sent. Your location is never saved. When you sign in we receive your name and email from Google; if you stay signed in, a small cookie on this device holds them for up to 7 days.
messages.delete.how: To remove it: tap the button below. It signs you out and clears the cookie on this device.
messages.delete.google: To also remove the app's access from Google: open your Google Account, go to Security, then third-party apps and services, and remove Pushkara Mitra.
messages.delete.done: Done. This app holds nothing about you on this device or on our servers.
messages.delete.notSignedIn: You are not signed in, so this app holds nothing about you on this device.
